unit_cn: Unit 1 People of Achievement 杰出人物
source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 1 词表(真词;跳过专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、杰出人物/科研/成就主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Winning the Nobel Prize was her greatest achievement.
words.example_cn: 获得诺贝尔奖是她最伟大的成就。

words.example_en: She was awarded the Nobel Prize for Physiology or Medicine.
words.example_cn: 她被授予诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。

words.example_en: Her research played a crucial role in treating malaria.
words.example_cn: 她的研究在治疗疟疾中起了至关重要的作用。

words.example_en: Artemisinin has become a vital treatment for malaria.
words.example_cn: 青蒿素已成为治疗疟疾的重要药物。

words.meaning_cn: 必不可少的;极其重要的;充满生机的
words.example_en: Her work was a vital part of the fight against the disease.
words.example_cn: 她的工作是抗击这种疾病的重要一环。

words.meaning_cn: 尽心尽力的;坚定的;忠诚的
words.example_en: Tu Youyou was a committed and patient scientist.
words.example_cn: 屠呦呦是一位尽心尽力且有耐心的科学家。

words.example_en: The team was formed with the objective of finding a new medicine.
words.example_cn: 这个团队的成立目标是找到一种新药。

words.example_en: She searched ancient texts for botanical treatments.
words.example_cn: 她在古籍中寻找植物类疗法。

words.example_en: Her team had to evaluate thousands of plants for their medical value.
words.example_cn: 她的团队不得不评估数千种植物的药用价值。

words.meaning_cn: 清晰的;有区别的;截然不同的
words.example_en: They tested 380 distinct ancient treatments.
words.example_cn: 他们测试了380种各不相同的古代疗法。

words.example_en: She used the extract from sweet wormwood to treat the disease.
words.example_cn: 她用青蒿的提取物来治疗这种疾病。

words.example_en: At first the team tried to boil the wormwood leaves.
words.example_cn: 起初团队尝试煮青蒿叶。

words.example_en: They used the liquid obtained from the plant to treat patients.
words.example_cn: 他们用从植物中得到的液体来治疗病人。

words.example_en: She finally obtained a substance that worked.
words.example_cn: 她最终得到了一种有效的物质。

words.example_en: At a lower temperature she found a substance that cured malaria.
words.example_cn: 在较低温度下她发现了一种能治愈疟疾的物质。

words.example_en: The team insisted on testing the medicine on themselves.
words.example_cn: 团队坚持在自己身上测试这种药。

words.example_en: Tu Youyou would not acknowledge defeat after many failures.
words.example_cn: 经历多次失败后,屠呦呦也不肯认输。

words.example_en: Boiling apparently destroyed the medical properties of the plant.
words.example_cn: 煮沸显然破坏了这种植物的药用性质。

words.example_en: Einstein gradually became famous throughout the world.
words.example_cn: 爱因斯坦逐渐闻名于世。

words.example_en: Einstein was not only a genius but also a kind man.
words.example_cn: 爱因斯坦不仅是个天才,也是个善良的人。

words.example_en: People remember him as a gentle and kind figure.
words.example_cn: 人们记得他是个温柔善良的人。

words.example_en: He made numerous contributions to modern physics.
words.example_cn: 他对现代物理学做出了许多贡献。

words.example_en: His general theory of relativity changed science forever.
words.example_cn: 他的广义相对论永远改变了科学。

words.example_en: His famous formula E=mc2 is known around the world.
words.example_cn: 他著名的公式 E=mc2 闻名世界。

words.example_en: Out of a strong passion for knowledge, he kept studying.
words.example_cn: 出于对知识的强烈热爱,他不断学习。

words.example_en: He earned a doctorate in physics in 1905.
words.example_cn: 他在1905年获得物理学博士学位。

words.meaning_cn: 不一般的;非凡的;意想不到的
words.example_en: That year he published four extraordinary physics papers.
words.example_cn: 那一年他发表了四篇非凡的物理学论文。

words.example_en: Circumstances changed in 1933, when Hitler came to power.
words.example_cn: 1933年希特勒上台,情况发生了变化。

words.example_en: As a consequence, Einstein had to leave Germany.
words.example_cn: 结果,爱因斯坦不得不离开德国。

words.example_en: He had to flee Germany because he was Jewish.
words.example_cn: 因为是犹太人,他不得不逃离德国。

words.meaning_cn: 社会公共机构;制度;习俗
words.example_en: He found the doors of academic institutions closed to him.
words.example_cn: 他发现学术机构的大门对他关闭了。

words.meaning_cn: 非凡的;显著的;不寻常的
words.example_en: His remarkable achievements made him a hero to many.
words.example_cn: 他非凡的成就使他成为许多人心中的英雄。

words.meaning_cn: 偶然碰到;遇到;邂逅;遭遇
words.example_en: Einstein often encountered people who asked for his help.
words.example_cn: 爱因斯坦常常遇到向他求助的人。

words.example_en: The whole world mourned the loss of the great scientist.
words.example_cn: 全世界都为这位伟大科学家的离世而哀悼。

words.example_en: Lu Xun is regarded as one of China's greatest novelists.
words.example_cn: 鲁迅被视为中国最伟大的小说家之一。

words.example_en: He drew on his life to write this famous novel.
words.example_cn: 他借鉴自己的人生写下了这部著名小说。

words.example_en: Florence Nightingale founded modern nursing.
words.example_cn: 弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔创立了现代护理学。

words.example_en: People often mistook him for Professor Einstein.
words.example_cn: 人们常把他误认作爱因斯坦教授。

words.example_en: It is an honour for China's scientific research.
words.example_cn: 这是中国科研的一种荣耀。

words.example_en: She came to the conclusion that boiling destroyed the medicine.
words.example_cn: 她得出结论:煮沸破坏了药效。

words.example_en: From her words we can infer how hard the work was.
words.example_cn: 从她的话中我们能推断出这项工作有多艰难。

words.example_en: He wrote a first draft of his speech about the great scientist.
words.example_cn: 他写了一篇关于这位伟大科学家的演讲初稿。

words.example_en: The writer used a clever device to introduce the hero.
words.example_cn: 作者用了一个巧妙的手法来引出这位英雄。

words.meaning_cn: 专利;专利证书;有专利的
words.example_en: Einstein once worked as a clerk in the patent office.
words.example_cn: 爱因斯坦曾在专利局当职员。

words.example_en: His fame was gained through years of hard work.
words.example_cn: 他的名声是通过多年的辛勤工作赢得的。

words.example_en: Great people often show courage when others give up.
words.example_cn: 在别人放弃时,伟人往往展现出勇气。

words.example_en: She said the honour was not just hers but the whole team's.
words.example_cn: 她说这份荣誉不只属于她,而是属于整个团队。

words.example_en: He made a great contribution to the fight against the disease.
words.example_cn: 他为抗击这种疾病做出了巨大贡献。
